title: Morehead Planetarium

services.name: Admission
services.desc: See a planetarium show in our GSK Fulldome Theater and get general admission with the same bundled ticket! Bundled tickets are available online through our calendar and in person at the Box Office while tickets remain available. Tickets go on sale online two weeks in advance and will remain available up to 1 hour

services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Morehead is now open to the public Friday through Sunday as we make room for all our stellar field trips. For more info, please check out our Plan A Visit page. Named as a Best Place to Host a Kid’s Birthday Party by Chapel Hill Magazine, celebrate a new orbit around the sun at Morehead Planetarium and Science Center with free admission, a planetarium show, and a party room. Our Event & Rental staff will contact you within 3-5 business days of receiving your request to discuss your inquiry and/or send you a tentative invoice and itinerary for your reservation.
